notes.title: Demo Update 1.1
notes.content:
- Fixed an exploit where players could stay in safety in the hallway while looking for the Mimic
- Added a prompt telling you to stay alive even if you destroy the wrong item
- Added a wishlist button and minor promotions in the main menu
- Added a "Thank you for playing" prompt at the end of the demo
- Dead players now respawn in the lobby if at least one player survives
- Adjusted post-processing effects to make the game more spooky
